name: Group Mentions
author: @Hikerys
summary: Native saved username groups with whole-command expansion and a per-chat cooldown.
limitations: Requires native engine API 8. Up to five groups of seven usernames; configure on the plugin page.
Plain text and unformatted captions only. Broadcasts, secret chats, formatted text and scheduled messages are excluded. A 60-second cooldown applies per account/chat.
